set_name: Bảo Khí Trấn Thủ Long Vi
campaign_acquisition: Reserved for sequential quests; no automatic campaign grant

items.name: Ngọc Bội Nguyệt Ảnh
items.description: A pale jade pendant bearing a moon above the waters of Long Vi. Its quiet radiance wards the bearer against hostile sorcery.

items.name: Giáp Sơn Văn Long Vi
items.description: Mountain-pattern armour edged in bronze, forged for the defender of Long Vi. Each interlocking plate bears the oath of its maker.

items.name: Ấn Trấn Thủ
items.description: The Warden's seal authenticates every order sent from Long Vi. Beneath its authority, wavering soldiers find the resolve to stand.

items.name: Nguyệt Đăng
items.description: A small bronze lantern burning with silver light. Its steady flame draws the Winds into harmony around the Warden.

items.name: Kiếm Trấn Dạ
items.description: Night is the Warden's watch, not his enemy. This enchanted blade cuts through the workings of those who would turn darkness against Long Vi.
